name: Sex Chuudoku ~Ano Ko ga Seido ni Naru made~
original_name: セックス注毒 ～あの娘が性奴になるまで～
source:
Otaku (protagonist) was a fat 3rd year college nerd.
One day on his way to school he injured himself, and was helped by a Ayano (heroine).
She was beautiful and pure, and like many, Otaku fell in love with her at first sight.

One day he saw her walking to school with another boy.
This was Teruo, a smart sensitive handsome nice guy.
Otaku tailed them to Ayano's house.

(Why is she taking him home? She loves ME.... ME...)
(... I won't forgive this....!!)

His heart shattered, Otaku began his secret revenge plan. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE087290.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
御宅族（主人公）是一个肥胖的大三宅男。某天在上学途中他受了伤，被绫乃（女主角）所救。她美丽而纯洁，和许多人一样，御宅族对她一见钟情。

某天他看到她和另一个男孩一起上学。那个男孩名叫辉夫，聪明、体贴、帅气、善良。御宅族跟踪他们来到了绫乃的家。

（为什么她要带他回家？她爱的是我……我……）

（……我不会原谅这件事的……！！）

心碎的御宅族开始了他秘密的复仇计划。
